create_evaluation_result_from_dict: create an EvaluationResult from a metrics dictionary using the from_dict class method
convert_evaluation_result_to_dict: convert an EvaluationResult back to a plain metrics dictionary using to_dict
check_evaluation_result_has_artifacts: check if an EvaluationResult contains any attached artifacts using has_artifacts
get_evaluation_result_artifact_keys: get a list of all artifact keys stored in an EvaluationResult using get_artifact_keys
get_evaluation_result_total_artifact_siz: get the total size of all artifacts in bytes using get_total_artifact_size
